CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:30 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

October 24, 2023

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M.

B. ROLL CALL:

Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

Absent:
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

All items listed under Consent Calendar are considered by the Design Review Board to
be routine and will be enacted by one motion unless a citizen or Board Member requests
otherwise; in which case, the item will be removed for separate consideration.

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: September 26, 2023
Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted the
minutes of the September 26, 2023, regular meeting of the Design Review Board.

ITEM 2:  MINUTES: October 10, 2023
Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted the
minutes of the October 10, 2023, regular meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:
  • Chairman Udani moved to approve all consent items.
  • The second was by Vice Chair Hernandez.
  • The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

  1
 D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 3:  1201 South Atlantic Boulevard

  •  This is an application for sign improvements to an existing free-standing sign for
  a gas station commercial property, including a new cabinet sign below existing
  pricer sign and moving the existing ‘Rocket’ cabinet sign down, and illuminated
  numbering to match existing LED manufacturer.
  •  Applicant: Richard Guadamuz
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  •  Discussion: Applicant Richard Guadamuz was not present. Board Member
  Hernandez asked Staff if this is the only signage in question. Staff answered yes,
  the applicant is for one free standing sign.

MOTION:

  •  Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application without conditions.
  •  The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ITEM 4:  130 East Valley Boulevard

  •  This is an application for one (1) new commercial sign on an existing wall of an
  existing 1-story commercial building on a single parcel for one tenant.
  •  Applicant: Christina Yu and Ken Le
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  •  Discussion: Applicants were present. Board Member Hernandez asked Staff if
  the black backing of the sign is existing. Staff answered yes, the backing is
  existing to remain and the proposed signage will be attached to the existing
  backing.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following conditions: 1) The applicant shall provide a height dimension for the
  proposed signage with respect to the ground level; and 2) The applicant must
  resubmit a revised set of plans for the City Architect to review.
  •  The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

  2
 ITEM 5:  1004 Benito Avenue

  •  This is an application for site improvements for the front yard of an existing 1-story
  single-family residence that includes new planter with gravel, new 33” high split-
  face retaining walls, and two (2) new 35” high pillars/columns at retaining wall
  corners.
  •  Applicant: Gerald Candelaria
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  •  Discussion: Applicant Gerald Candelaria was not present. Board Member Ng
  asked if the images on the applicant are showing what is existing or what is
  proposed and the applicant wishes to get approval for. Staff answered the
  images are showing work that has already been done without approval and the
  applicant is now requesting approved. Hernadez asked what are the items being
  proposed. Staff responded the retaining wall, gravel with potted plants, and
  possible light fixture at the corners. Udani notes the site plan should be added to
  the agenda packet and no light fixtures are being show on the images or in the
  staff report. Staff notes that the light fixtures were a verbal conversation with the
  applicant and will disregard the last comment. Ng agrees that all proposed work
  should be identify in the images or plans.

MOTION:

  •  Udani makes a motion to approve the application with the following conditions: 1)
  If there are any additional changes to the project scope, then the applicant shall
  return to Design Review Board for review and approval.
  •  The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ITEM 6:  2932 Pyranees Drive

  •  This is an application for new construction of a roof over an existing 2-car garage
  located at the front of the existing single-family residential property.
  •  Applicant: Andrew Mori
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  •  Discussion: Applicant Andrew Mori was not present. Board Member Ng asked if
  there is a side elevation provided as part of the agenda packet. Staff answered
  no, there was not an west or east elevation in the agenda packet for this project.
  Hernandez adds to Ng’s comment, by asking what is the intent for the void
  created by the pitch roof. Hernandez asks if the void created will be closed by
  continuing the wall up to the roof or will there be an opening created. Staff noted
  that the applicant is intending to in-fill the void created by the pitch roof with a
  stucco wall to match the existing stucco walls of the house. Ng notes this is not
  documented on the agenda packet.

  3
 MOTION:

  •  Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) The applicant shall provide a partial elevation of either the west or
  east side of the work area to identify that a new stucco wall be proposed to
  match the existing house; 2) The applicant shall identify and proposed vents, if
  needed; and 3) The applicant must resubmit a revised set of plans for the City
  Architect to review.
  •  The second was by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ITEM 7:  1410 South Atlantic Boulevard

  •  This is an application for exterior improvements to an existing 1-story Starbucks
  coffee building, including re-painting, new signage, and new metal canopy.
  •  Applicant: Emily Gustafson, Noelia Santiago, and Huda Alhassan
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  •  Discussion: The applicants were present. Board Member Ng asked if the white
  poles shown in the rendering are the existing light post on site. The applicant
  responded yes, the black light post are existing to remain as well as the planter
  boxes in the existing outdoor area. Hernandez asked if the landscaping is part of
  the scope of work. The applicant answered there are landscaping and drive thru
  site improvements but not part of the scope for this design review. Ng asked if
  the existing signage is to remain or is there new proposed signage. The applicant
  answered the signage is new black color that is most likely going to be back-lit.
  Hernandez clarifies that the metal canopies being proposed are shown as
  keynote 12 and 13. Hernandez asks if the drive thru block wall is to remain or is it
  being replaced. Staff answered the wall is an existing block wall to be painted
  with new paint.

MOTION:

  •  Ng makes a motion to approve the application with the following conditions: 1)
  The applicant shall update the plans and renderings to show the location and
  existing color of the light post; 2) The applicant shall provide signage details such
  as identifying if the signage is back-lit or illuminated through the lettering; and 3)
  The applicant must resubmit a revised set of plans for the City Architect to
  review.
  •  The second was by Board Member Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

  4
 E. ADJOURNMENT:

  •  We will adjourn to the next meeting on October 24, 2023.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Hernandez moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:10 P.M.
  •  The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ATTEST:

_____________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary

  5
